The centred 2 × 2 × 2 cube and a perpendicular bore of radius 1/2
are rotated 45° about Y. The bore removes volume π/2 and two discs
totalling π/2 in area. Its wall adds area 2π. The centroid stays at the
origin by symmetry and the box corners determine the bounds, which
extend √2 units on either side along X and Z and one unit along Y.

The workplane translation of 10¹⁷ along its own normal preserves the
bore's axis (ADR-0024 §A). Rounding the translated world coordinates
separately can displace the axis sideways enough to miss the stock.
